visualRisks.description: Water and road colors are similar (#007fff and #ffd700), which might cause visual confusion.
visualRisks.recommendation: Consider using more distinct colors for water and roads.

visualRisks.description: The lighthouse color (#f0e68c) is very similar to the dock color (#87cefa).
visualRisks.recommendation: Distinguish these two elements with different colors.

navigationRisks.description: The route path includes a large number of steps (up to 114), which might be overwhelming for players.
navigationRisks.recommendation: Simplify the route or provide hints and checkpoints.

navigationRisks.description: There are no clear visual indicators for the start and end points of the route, making it harder for players to navigate.
navigationRisks.recommendation: Add distinct markers at the beginning and end of the route.
